_comment: Curated per-quant weights-bytes and architecture facts for VRAM estimation. Each entry's _comment states whether its figures are research-sourced (from ollama.com tags page or registry.ollama.ai manifest API, cited in llm/research/v024-vram-quantization.md) or plausible+documented (reasonable estimates for seed coverage, to be replaced on next offline tool refresh). The source field identifies the data source for provenance tracking; it does not indicate figure quality. VRAMBytes and VRAMContextTokens are NOT stored here — they are computed and baked by the codegen caller (cmd/bestiary-gen) using EstimateVRAMBytes.

models._comment: Research-sourced: arch facts from Meta-Llama-3.3-70B public model card (layers=80, kv_heads=8, head_dim=128, context_window=131072). weights_bytes from ollama.com/library/llama3.3/tags page (Q4_K_M ~42.5 GB, Q8_0 ~75 GB, F16 ~141 GB) as of 2026-06-09.

Plausible+documented: weights_bytes estimated from ollama.com/library/llama3.2 tags page size display (~2.0 GB Q4_K_M, ~3.2 GB Q8_0). Arch facts absent (exercises partial-VRAM path). Refresh with offline tool for authoritative figures.

Plausible+documented: weights_bytes estimated from ollama.com/library/qwen2.5 tags page (~397 MB Q4_K_M for 0.5B). Arch facts absent (exercises partial-VRAM path). Refresh with offline tool for authoritative figures.

Plausible+documented: community finetune of llama-3-70b-instruct. weights_bytes are a plausible estimate for a 70B Q4_K_M model; arch facts copied from the base. base_ref exercises the codegen finetune-lineage inference path. Refresh with offline tool for authoritative figures.
